title: CA mapped abandoned mine features
provider: California DOC / Division of Mine Reclamation
currentTake: Core BLM screening layer; high relevance to BLM-CA and water-quality screening. Must caveat generalized/obfuscated/incomplete locations.
firstAuditTask: Inspect fields, status categories, query/GeoJSON support, symbology, and mandatory caveat text.

title: Principal Areas of Mine Pollution / mine pollution areas
provider: California DOC / Division of Mine Reclamation
currentTake: Potentially more hydrology-relevant than mine points if accessible.
firstAuditTask: Find actual downloadable GIS/service endpoint and determine public BRIM appropriateness.

title: Active mines / SMARA / DOC mine status
provider: California DOC / Division of Mine Reclamation
currentTake: AML alone is not enough; current regulated mining matters for pits, tailings, reclamation, and water quality.
firstAuditTask: Identify mine-status service and layer IDs from DOC/DMR map services.

title: California NCCAG / groundwater-dependent ecosystems / iGDE
currentTake: One of the biggest hydro/ecology gaps; valuable for springs, wetlands, phreatophytes, SGMA/GDE context. Screening/start-point only.
firstAuditTask: Confirm layer names, fields, legends, display scale, and DWR/NCCAG disclaimer language.

title: 303(d) / 305(b) impaired waters / TMDL context
provider: California State Water Resources Control Board
sourceStatus: Known service lead but currency must be verified
currentTake: Core hydro screening layer; high BRIM value. Currency/listing cycle must be verified.
firstAuditTask: Verify current/best Water Boards service for latest 303(d)/305(b)/TMDL layers and identify sublayers.

title: DWR / TRE Altamira InSAR land subsidence
currentTake: High-value groundwater stress/subsidence layer, especially Central Valley and infrastructure context.
firstAuditTask: Resolve current CNRA/DWR data URL, format, time slices, and best summary layer for BRIM.

title: NOHRSC snow analysis — snow depth and SWE
currentTake: Strong easy add; complements BRIM station SWE layer with gridded snow context.
firstAuditTask: Identify correct Snow Depth and SWE layer IDs, units, legend, transparency, and exportImage behavior.

title: SPC fire weather outlooks
currentTake: Very strong BLM/BRIM fit, especially with wind, fire, drought, and hazards.
firstAuditTask: Inspect sublayer IDs, category fields, update/valid time fields, legend, and source-link fields.

title: SPC mesoscale discussions
currentTake: Worth real estate even if initially a link; excellent active-event situational awareness.
firstAuditTask: Check fields for MD number, issue/valid/expire times, discussion URL, and current/expired behavior.

title: SPC convective outlooks
currentTake: Popular and easy; useful situational context but less CA-core than fire weather.
firstAuditTask: Identify day/risk/probability layer IDs and valid-time fields.

title: WPC Winter Storm Severity Index
currentTake: Impact framing is decision-friendly; useful but seasonal.
firstAuditTask: Inspect layer IDs, category values, legend, and day/time sublayers.

title: CPC Day 8–14 hazards / rapid-onset drought / week-2 hazards
serviceTypeGuess: Unknown; likely GIS download/feed or web product
currentTake: Good compact NOAA next-week risk layer, especially heat, wind, snow, and rapid-onset drought.
firstAuditTask: Resolve ArcGIS/GeoJSON/shapefile feed and category mapping if available.

title: CPC Week 3–4 outlooks
currentTake: Useful planning context, but compact only.
firstAuditTask: Find GIS-ready service/download if available and compare to existing CPC layers in BRIM.

title: CPC monthly / seasonal outlooks
currentTake: Good background context, not main real estate.
firstAuditTask: Find best GIS-ready source and decide map-layer vs link-only.

title: NOAA National Water Model Land Analysis near-surface soil moisture saturation
provider: NOAA / NWS / Office of Water Prediction
layerIds: Audit 0,3 and all named soil moisture layers
currentTake: Easiest soil-moisture add; good first pass despite lower interpretability than percentiles.
firstAuditTask: Confirm correct layer ID, units, legend, exportImage parameters, and update timestamp metadata.

title: NASA SPoRT-LIS soil moisture percentiles
currentTake: Best soil-moisture meaning because percentiles/anomalies beat raw saturation for decisions.
firstAuditTask: Find actual current SPoRT-LIS data/service endpoint and identify shallow/root-zone percentile layers.

title: CPC NLDAS Noah soil moisture percentiles
currentTake: Good interpretable NOAA/CPC backup.
firstAuditTask: Find GIS-ready endpoint/download and compare redundancy with SPoRT-LIS and NWM.

title: Crop-CASMA soil moisture anomaly
currentTake: Anomaly is useful, but behind SPoRT/NWM/CPC for BRIM priority.
firstAuditTask: Check if current anomaly raster is available in a BRIM-friendly endpoint.

title: SMAP / GRACE broad soil moisture products
sourceStatus: Source pool only unless easy endpoint found
currentTake: Scientifically useful, but probably too coarse for first-round BRIM.
firstAuditTask: Only audit after higher-priority soil moisture/vegetation products.

title: Better wind — NOAA surface observations / MADIS wind barbs
currentTake: Best near-term fix for weak sparse wind layer.
firstAuditTask: Identify wind-specific sublayers, fields, scales, symbology options, and whether custom symbolization is possible.

title: NDFD / gridded forecast wind
currentTake: Probably more useful than more station points if implemented cleanly.
firstAuditTask: Resolve best forecast wind endpoint, layer names, valid-time controls, and legend.

title: QuickDRI
currentTake: Strongest recent drydown / flash drought vegetation-drought layer.
firstAuditTask: Find GIS endpoint/download and determine tiles/raster overlay feasibility.

title: VegDRI
currentTake: Better than raw NDVI because drought stress is already interpreted.
firstAuditTask: Find GIS endpoint/download, category legend, and current update cadence.

title: NOAA STAR VHI / VCI / TCI vegetation health
currentTake: Interpreted vegetation-health family; better than raw greenness.
firstAuditTask: Identify VHI/VCI/TCI data formats and whether web tiles or static preprocessing are best.

title: NOAA STAR NDVI / greenness products
currentTake: Keep, but raw greenness needs anomaly/context to be decision-useful.
firstAuditTask: Check whether anomaly/percentile-style products are available from same source.

title: NASA GIBS MODIS/VIIRS NDVI-style imagery
sourceStatus: Known service family; layer names TBD
currentTake: Technically promising web imagery but should stay explore-tier unless date/legend is clean.
firstAuditTask: Fetch WMTS capabilities, identify NDVI/vegetation layers, time dimension, and Leaflet syntax.

title: Railroads
provider: FRA / BTS / NTAD / Esri service lead
currentTake: Good compact ROW/context layer.
firstAuditTask: Verify service source, date, fields, query support, and CA extent performance.

title: Major highways / National Highway System
currentTake: Cleaner than all-roads and useful for ROW/access screening.
firstAuditTask: Inspect layer IDs/fields, scale visibility, and whether functional class alternatives are needed.

title: Electric transmission lines
currentTake: High relevance, but vet source before trusting in BRIM.
firstAuditTask: Compare HIFLD, EIA, CEC, and authoritative CA transmission services; choose best public endpoint.

title: Electric substations
currentTake: Useful but compact/explore treatment is safer.
firstAuditTask: Determine whether public display is appropriate and whether fields are useful.

title: CalGEM oil/gas/geothermal wells, fields, leases, notices, permits
sourceStatus: Known service lead, but full well services need audit
currentTake: Strong hydro/contamination/legacy infrastructure relevance.
firstAuditTask: Find best CalGEM services for well locations/status, fields, leases, and permits; define compact layer set.

title: DRECP / renewable energy zones / conservation designations
provider: CEC / BLM / CDFW / USFWS / Data Basin
currentTake: Very BLM-CA relevant for desert ROW, solar/wind/geothermal, washes, groundwater, and conservation.
firstAuditTask: Resolve authoritative layer package/service for DRECP BLM land-use plan designations and renewable energy areas.

title: BLM CA renewable energy projects
sourceStatus: Needs endpoint audit from hub item
currentTake: Useful for cumulative development context and BLM ROW work.
firstAuditTask: Open hub item metadata and locate exact data/service URL and fields.

title: BLM CA recreation sites / recreation areas / OHV
currentTake: Useful near springs, water access, campgrounds, OHV, recreation areas, and visitor impacts.
firstAuditTask: Inspect fields/categories and choose a compact subset or category styling.

title: CAL FIRE / FRAP vegetation, fuels, burn severity
currentTake: Fuels, vegetation, and burn severity matter for watershed condition and post-fire hydrology.
firstAuditTask: Find authoritative FRAP services for vegetation/fuels/burn severity and choose non-duplicative BRIM layers.

title: SWPC space-weather alerts, watches, warnings, K-index
currentTake: Mostly link/status value, not a core BRIM map layer.
firstAuditTask: Check whether compact status link is worthwhile; otherwise defer.

title: SWPC aurora 30-minute forecast
currentTake: Real geospatial forecast concept but mostly novelty for BRIM.
firstAuditTask: Defer unless adding compact NOAA explore bucket.
